title.en: Talorys: A Self-Hosted AI Agent on Cloudflare

excerpt.zh: Talorys把聊天、记忆、任务和提醒部署到用户自己的Cloudflare账户，强调单用户与无遥测，但免费额度并非无限。
excerpt.en: Talorys runs chat, memory, tasks, and reminders in your Cloudflare account, with no telemetry, but free-tier quotas still apply.

text.zh: Talorys：把个人AI助手放进自己的云账户
text.en: Talorys: A Personal AI Agent in Your Own Cloud Account

text.zh: Talorys是一个开源、自托管的个人AI助手，运行在用户自己的Cloudflare账户中。它提供聊天、可编辑的记忆、任务、笔记、项目，以及一次性或周期性提醒，并通过一条命令完成部署。项目按单用户设计，不要求注册账号，也不向开发者发送遥测、分析或广告数据。
text.en: Talorys is an open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent that runs in the user's own Cloudflare account. It offers chat, editable memories, tasks, notes, projects, and one-time or recurring reminders, with deployment handled by a single command. It is designed for one user, requires no signup, and sends no telemetry, analytics, or advertising data to its developers.

text.zh: 前端托管在Cloudflare Pages，页面函数通过服务绑定把请求转发到没有公开URL的私有Worker。数据、会话和应用状态保存在由Durable Objects支持的SQLite中，提醒依靠闹钟调度；聊天模型使用Workers AI，并支持流式响应和工具调用。安装器会检查登录状态、创建资源、配置密钥并验证部署，后续也支持更新、备份和密码重置。
text.en: The frontend runs on Cloudflare Pages, while a Pages Function forwards requests through a service binding to a Worker without a public URL. Data, sessions, and application state are stored in SQLite-backed Durable Objects, and alarms drive scheduled reminders. Chat uses Workers AI with streaming responses and tool calling. The installer checks authentication, creates resources, configures secrets, and verifies the deployment; updates, backups, and password resets are also supported.

text.zh: 自托管AI的隐私边界与免费额度
text.en: The Limits of Self-Hosted AI and the Free Tier

text.zh: 自托管并不意味着数据完全离开云服务商：Cloudflare仍会处理账户中的数据，并为Workers AI推理处理聊天内容及相关记忆。项目声称适配免费计划，但免费额度受请求数、Durable Objects使用量和每日AI配额限制，且这些规则可能变化；超出配额后，AI聊天会暂停，任务和简单提醒仍可继续。真正的成本、隐私与安全边界，仍取决于Cloudflare条款、账户配置以及用户对密码和备份的管理。
text.en: Self-hosting does not mean data leaves the cloud provider: Cloudflare still processes account data and handles chat messages and relevant memories for Workers AI inference. The project is designed for the free plan, but quotas cover requests, Durable Objects usage, and daily AI allocation, and those rules can change. When AI capacity runs out, chat pauses while tasks and simple reminders continue. The practical cost, privacy, and security boundaries therefore still depend on Cloudflare's terms, account configuration, and the user's handling of passwords and backups.
